claims.label: Development Agreement Breach
claims.note: Small, success-skewed research sample -- treat the probability range as directional.

outcome.description: After an October 2022 bench trial the district court found the City breached the Development Agreement (and tortiously interfered with the construction loan) and awarded Parking LLC $4,353,677 in expectancy damages (garage development fee, savings under the stipulated price, and interest) against the City, rejecting all other claimed damages and the City's counterclaims; court costs were taxed to the City. The Iowa Supreme Court affirmed the breach-of-contract judgment and the $4,353,677 award on June 12, 2026, vacated the tortious-interference judgment, and affirmed the denial of the Developers' additional damages.
outcome.finalNote: Damages affirmed; tortious-interference liability vacated without changing the amount.

source.caseName: 5th and Walnut Parking LLC, 5th and Walnut Tower LLC, 5th and Court LLC, Justin Mandelbaum, and Sean Mandelbaum v. City of Des Moines
source.court: Iowa Supreme Court, on appeal from the Iowa District Court for Polk County (Business Specialty Court)
source.excerptNote: Verbatim from Part I (Background Facts and Proceedings, sections A-E, selected paragraphs) plus the neutral list of the Developers' damages categories and the sentences stating the amounts they requested for categories (1-D), (2-A/B/D), (3) and (4), taken from Part III.B. Removed: the introduction, the Lincoln Savings/Bankers Trust financing and alley-delay paragraph and the May-September 2019 extension talks (length) (award and disposition), the Section 10.1(A)/10.4 contract text, several correspondence paragraphs, the City's counterclaims and summary-judgment procedure, the district court's findings and judgment, footnotes 1-2 and their markers, the sentence stating the affirmed Category (1) award, every sentence reporting how the district court ruled on each damages category, and all analysis and holdings. The foreclosure-fees figure is omitted because the only sentence stating it reports the court's finding.
